name: Rents for dwellings (Statistics Sweden BO0406)

measures.definition: Sitting rent: the median annual rent of every rented 2-room dwelling (one bedroom; Swedish rooms leave out the kitchen) in Stockholm municipality, divided by 12. Mostly rents set by negotiation, not what a newcomer pays on the second-hand market.
Sitting rent: the median annual rent of every rented dwelling of 4 rooms or more (three bedrooms or more) in Stockholm municipality, divided by 12.

rights.attribution: Source: Statistics Sweden, rents for dwellings (BO0406)

caveats: Swedish first-hand rents are negotiated and allocated by queue; a newcomer often rents second hand at a higher price, which this figure does not show.
